entries.0e7ce144ec6cd6f4: A tutoring school consisting of an individual tutoring division and a class instruction division. Mainly under 'Kobetsu Shido Gakuin Free Step', individual tutoring is also operated under the names 'Kaisei Kyoiku Group Sundai Diverse', 'Free Step 1-on-1 Senmon-kan Sophia', 'Chugaku Juken/Daigaku Juken Senmon Kobetsu Shido Arusupōto', 'Shinken Zemi Kobetsu Shido Course' and 'Jisedaigata Kobetsu Shido Juku Sumanabi'; Free Step also operates a franchise business. Class instruction based on class formation by academic level is provided under the names 'Kaisei Kyoiku Seminar' and 'Ēru Shingaku Kyōshitsu', and it also operates 'Ikkai Juku', specializing in preparation for medical school and highly competitive university entrance examinations. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12,595 million.
